values.body:
The [contact form](/contact) isn’t written into the site. It’s the **Contact** form on the admin’s Forms page, and the site fetches its fields from the CMS and renders them with Sorlo Forms, so a change to the form shows on the site at once.

## Submissions

The browser sends each submission straight to the CMS, which checks it against the form’s fields and keeps it in the form’s inbox. A honeypot field and a rate limit keep most spam out.

## Automations

An automation runs actions when something changes. The starter has two:

- **Email contact submissions** emails each one that isn’t spam. In development, the CMS prints the email in its terminal instead of sending it.
- **Revalidate the site** calls the site’s `/api/revalidate` whenever something is published, which the post on publishing explains.
values.title: Forms and automations
values.author: 01a1ca0a-d2b1-7cb2-9b1f-92ffdcf35565
